# Moonbeam X-cost consume/copy boundary

Natural sample14,Underlegion/LunaCoven,seed934692550,Ring5. Original Moonbeam
`8916c550-474d-49db-89bf-75bacdc95db4`,instance26,has the original single
nonremovable played-cost application trait,ChaosScepter(+20 damage/heal and
Consume),then CreateSpellCopyWithPurge. The original150 model rejects even
champion deployment because its global copy guard excludes this authored trait.

The native150 rejection witness is
`.probe-runs/full-battle-units-spells-and-junk-20261026-190516-bfce475a/unsupported-branch-native.mt2f`.
The repaired model replays that complete successor/RNG and rejects five altered
identity/trait signatures. Development151 additionally accepts the exact original
source trait alongside copied Consume,keeps copied scaling before the purge
upgrade,and checks effective damage against the existing permanent/temporary
magic-power resolver instead of requiring the unupgraded20 damage.

Native source confirms the application trait only reads played cost and has no
discard callback. CopyOnPlay creates an authored card,then copies upgrades and
installs the temporary purge/replacement upgrade. The ordinary Consume must
still precede the copy callback; unrelated signatures remain rejected.

Separate original-spell/copy execution and independent native replay are pending.
The model's seven-input route naturally draws Moonbeam on turn4,casts it at4
energy,creates copy31,and casts that copy at0 energy. This route alone is not
native acceptance and is not a Ring5 win.
